start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-paid-access-grants with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and grants [{\"subject\": \"member@example.com\", \"access_ref\": \"access:sample-course\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the access grants are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-paid-access-grants" with store, and grants (who holds access by hand, and which access ref) and revoke (whose grant ends, by its grant_ref) as you want them kept.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every answer must be the one the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Read what came back: written, already, and each refused item with its position and why. A refused grant whose reference was ended needs a new grant_ref; nothing is changed for it.
